en-US.description: An independent agent workspace and full harness for coding, research, and other project work.
en-US.longDescription: Varin is an independent agent workspace and full harness for coding, research, and other project work, centered on local and desktop experiences. It bundles the Pi runtime: the model and provider stack, session tree, package manager, and extension model remain Pi-owned, while Varin owns the surrounding tool environment, working state, recovery, retrieval, context policy, task governance, and workbench surfaces. Varin ships two first-party working shapes: an Agent Workspace centered on sessions, tasks, and context, and an IDE Workbench centered on editors, search, Git, diagnostics, and debugging with the agent as a dockable panel.
en-US.releaseNotes:
Varin 0.9.37 improves Windows process cleanup, model settings, delegation, external agents, and extension execution.
Desktop and workspace reliability
- Fixed a chat crash when a question card renders before its operation snapshot arrives, including reopening with cached history. Chat errors now recover independently for each conversation and expose copyable error details.
- Fixed Windows terminal shutdown hanging on remaining PTY clients. The native process owner now drains its retained descendants before closing the console, including Git Bash exit and guardian-loss cleanup.
- Fixed concurrent configuration reads racing atomic file replacement, and protected native workspace resource publication from cleanup.
- Improved workspace directory indexing with batched tree updates and reused database statements.
- Reserved the native macOS window controls in the IDE titlebar.
Models, settings, and delegation
- Redesigned model services around connection drafts and immediate model editing, with clearer model metadata and outside-click dismissal for the model drawer.
- Added Bot model thinking preferences, simplified Bot settings, opened memory editing in place, and collapsed the avatar library by default.
- Added durable model preparation for delegated tasks and unified Agent settings actions with the actual settings owner and result receipts.
- Made the Rust Catalog own durable environment observations, keeping original delivery identities through recovery.
External agents and extensions
- Expanded Codex, Claude Code, Pi, and ACP integrations with native model and session options, connection preparation, cancellation, and recovery handling. ACP presets remain dependent on the installed external program and its actual capabilities.
- Added independently scheduled Run driver extensions while retaining the original execution permissions, operations, checkpoints, and recovery bindings. The built-in Rust driver remains the default.
- Connected public Surface authoring and clarified the code-trust boundary for extensions. Improved candidate storage recovery, original service bindings, broker readiness, and shutdown of active readers.
- Fixed cancellation reporting so completed cleanup is distinguished from cancellation intent and unknown effects.

zh-CN.description: 面向编程与科研的独立 Agent 工作台与完整 Harness。
zh-CN.longDescription: Varin 是一个独立的 Agent 工作台与完整 Harness，面向编程、科研和其他项目工作，以本地和桌面体验为中心。它内置 Pi 运行时；模型与提供商栈、会话树、包管理器和扩展模型仍由 Pi 提供，而 Varin 负责周围的工具环境、工作状态、恢复、检索、上下文策略、任务治理和工作台界面。Varin 自带两套官方工作形态：以会话、任务和上下文为中心的 Agent Workspace，以及以编辑器、搜索、Git、诊断和调试为中心、把智能体作为可停靠面板的 IDE Workbench。
zh-CN.name: Varin
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
Varin 0.9.37 改善 Windows 进程清理、模型设置、任务委派、外部 Agent 与扩展执行。
桌面与工作区可靠性
- 修复问题选项卡先于操作快照到达时的聊天崩溃，包括重新打开时先显示缓存历史的情况。聊天错误按对话独立恢复，并提供可复制的错误详情。
- 修复 Windows 终端关闭时被遗留 PTY 客户端卡住的问题。原生进程所有者在关闭控制台前清理其保留的后代进程，覆盖 Git Bash 退出与守护进程意外结束后的回收。
- 修复配置读取与原子文件替换之间的并发冲突，防止原生工作区资源发布被清理流程干扰。
- 通过批量树更新和复用数据库语句，改善工作区目录索引性能。
- 为 macOS IDE 标题栏的原生窗口按钮预留空间。
模型、设置与任务委派
- 重做模型服务设置，支持连接草稿和即时模型编辑，改善模型元信息层级，并支持点击外部关闭模型抽屉。
- 增加 Bot 模型思考偏好，简化 Bot 设置，在原位置编辑记忆，并默认收起头像库。
- 为委派任务增加持久化模型准备流程，统一 Agent 设置操作与真实设置服务、结果回执。
- 将持久环境观察交由 Rust Catalog 管理，在恢复时保留原始投递身份。
外部 Agent 与扩展
- 完善 Codex、Claude Code、Pi 和 ACP 接入，覆盖原生模型与会话选项、连接准备、取消和恢复。ACP 预设的可用性仍取决于实际安装的外部程序及其能力。
- 支持独立调度的 Run driver 扩展，同时保留原执行权限、操作、检查点与恢复绑定；内置 Rust driver 仍为默认实现。
- 接通公开 Surface 编写入口，明确扩展代码信任边界，并改善候选数据恢复、原服务绑定、broker 就绪与活动读取的关闭流程。
- 修复取消状态报告，区分已完成的清理、取消意图与结果未知的副作用。
